headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while inflation and energy keep Stress extreme
body: Friday ended with the Nasdaq 0.96% higher and VIX near 15.6, while Brent remained above $104 and the U.S. 10-year yield stayed near 5%. With NQ closed for the weekly break, no live continuation, shallow-pullback, or failed-retracement evidence is available; Tail remains low while macro and geopolitical Stress stays extreme.
